name: Formula Pro TLR S-Light (Gen 6)

origin.basis: Inoue Rubber Co., Ltd. (IRC Tire) was founded in 1926 in Japan and has its head office in Nagoya (IRC about page).

manufacturing.basis: IRC does not state where this tire is made.

positioning: IRC's sixth-generation lightweight tubeless-ready race tire with a dual compound and RBCC2 tread.
hookless_note: IRC lists a hookless pressure range for every size, capped at 73 psi.

availability.note: IRC's US site sends buyers to local bike shops or the Pure Gravel web store; no price recorded. Mainland China and European availability not verified.

caveats: No independent lab test of the Gen 6 S-Light found; the lab-tested Formula Pro RBCC is a different tire.
